OUR STORY

THE JOURNEY
OF KRT.

2016
The Beginning
Kafrelsheikh Racing Team was founded at Faculty of Engineering, Kafrelsheikh University to build competitive racing machines.
Mission
Design, manufacture and develop innovative vehicles while building engineering skills through real motorsport challenges.
Vision
Become one of the leading Egyptian university racing teams competing internationally.
THE EVOLUTION OF KRT

EVERY CAR
LEFT A MARK.
